label: Every concrete thing that begins to be present has a concrete ground
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, a concrete individual that is absent at a moment and present at a strictly later moment has some concrete individual as a ground in that history, under the supplied world-relative grounding relation. Things present from the earliest moment of their history, and things never present, are unconstrained. The ground need not be a sufficient or deterministic cause, and nothing is said about its time of presence.
